subject: Clarify invoicing entity, withholding & payment path for Order Form
messages:
From: Megan O'Neil <megan.oneil@clearsky.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@clearsky.com>
Date: 2028-08-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoicing entity & withholding question for upcoming order form

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for sending the order form draft last week. Finance here has a couple of questions before we can issue a PO:

- Who should ClearSky pay (legal entity) — we have a US entity and a UK entity on file. Our AP team needs the exact invoicing entity and remit address.
- Regarding withholding: our treasury is asking whether ClearSky should withhold taxes for any portion of the fees. If so, we need the tax residency certificate or guidance to avoid double taxation.
- Net terms: our standard is net45, but we can request net30 depending on concession. Can you confirm Redwood's preferred net terms for this order and whether you accept split invoicing per quarter for the minimum commit?

Also, please attach the latest populated order form (with pricing schedule and per-quarter breakdown) so procurement can validate numbers against the contract.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — aiming to get the PO out by Friday.

Best,
Megan O'Neil
Sr. Procurement Manager
ClearSky Analytics

Attachments referenced: — (Megan requests the populated order form and details)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Megan O'Neil <megan.oneil@clearsky.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@clearsky.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoicing entity & withholding question for upcoming order form

Hi Megan —

Thanks — appreciate the heads up. Short answers up front:

- Invoicing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) — remit to the US bank details on the order form unless your procurement specifically requires an EU/UK invoice (in which case we can discuss entity routing).
- Withholding: by default the customer is responsible for any local withholding taxes. If ClearSky intends to withhold, we need a copy of your tax residency certificate and the withholding calculation in advance so we can provide a credit note/evidence.
- Net terms: our standard is net45 on new enterprise orders. We can consider net30 after we receive a PO and a vendor credit check (one-time). If you require split invoicing by quarter for the minimum commit, we can model that in the order form — I'll attach a version with quarterly invoice rows.

I've attached order_form_draft_v3.pdf with a per-quarter invoice breakdown and a tax_residency_template.xlsx that your tax team can fill out if withholding applies.

Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Jordan (finance) to confirm any redline risk on the withholding language and to confirm whether we should add a clause that conditions net30 on a successful credit check / PO receipt.

Next steps: once legal approves, I'll send a DocuSign with the final invoice entity and payment instructions and confirm the AP email to route invoices to.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: order_form_draft_v3.pdf, tax_residency_template.xlsx

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: megan.oneil@clearsky.com
Date: 2028-08-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoicing entity & withholding question for upcoming order form

Rafael / Jordan —

See legal's quick redline notes below (high level):

1) Net terms: preserve net45 as the default in the Order Form (consistent with our pricing schedule). If the customer requests net30, we should require either (a) a PO plus an approved credit application, or (b) an upfront partial payment equal to the first invoice. Suggested language: "Customer may request Net 30 upon submission of a Purchase Order and completion of Redwood's credit screening; absent approval, Net 45 applies."

2) Withholding: we cannot accept unilateral withholding that reduces the net consideration to Redwood without either (a) an offset payment from the customer or (b) an exemption certificate. We should add a clause: "If Customer withholds taxes, Customer shall provide official withholding calculation and applicable government forms within 30 days; Customer remains liable for grossed-up amounts if withholding reduces Redwood's net receipt."

3) Invoice entity mapping: we need an "Invoice Entity Schedule" appendix that lists invoice entity, remit address, and tax ID. That avoids back-and-forth. Jordan, can finance prepare a one-page table to attach to the order form?

4) Evidence: request tax residency certificate + legal attestation if the customer claims treaty benefits. Use the attached tax_residency_template.xlsx as guiding input.

I can produce a redline of the Order Form with the above clauses by EOD. If you want to offer net30 as a commercial concession to close this week, note that it should be tied to the PO and credit approval (not automatic).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Transactions
Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Megan O'Neil <megan.oneil@clearsky.com>, AP Team <ap@clearsky.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final: invoicing entity, withholding, and payment path (Order Form final attached)

Hi Megan / AP team —

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Per internal review and the attached final Order Form, here are the agreed commercial points for your PO:

1) Invoicing entity and remit: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — all invoices for this Order Form will be issued to ClearSky Analytics (US entity) and sent to AP@clearsky.com. Remit details embedded in the Order Form Appendix ("Invoice Entity Schedule").

2) Net terms: Net45 is our standard. We will accept Net30 as a one-time commercial concession contingent on ClearSky issuing a PO and completing the vendor credit check. If you want Net30 automatically, we need a signed credit addendum (see clause 2.1).

3) Split invoicing / minimum commit: we modeled the minimum commit as quarterly invoice lines in order_form_draft_v3.pdf and preserved the full commercial amount in the binding Order Form; invoices will be raised per quarter as per the schedule unless you request otherwise in the PO.

4) Withholding & tax residency: customer remains responsible for any local withholding unless an exemption certificate is provided. If withholding occurs, ClearSky must provide the official withholding calculation and tax residency documentation within 30 days; Redwood reserves the right to gross-up or issue a credit note as agreed in clause 3.4. Please use the attached tax_residency_template.xlsx to share the required info.

Next steps:
- I've attached order_form_final_signed.pdf for signature via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-123-XYZ
- Once signed, please send the PO referencing DEAL-4821 and confirm the AP email and remit instructions for routing.

If you want, I can arrange a 15-minute call between our AP/finance (Jordan) and your treasury to walk through the withholding flow so there are no surprises on the first invoice.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: order_form_final_signed.pdf, tax_residency_template.xlsx
